description.en: Oil UI 的 DeepSeek Harness 原生插件，支持自动切换本地安装的 Oil UI Pro
description.zh: untranslated

description.en: Nested folders, colored tags, and tree search for DeepSeek Harness.
A DeepSeek Harness plugin for Assistant Deepseek Budget.
A thin Feishu/Lark WebSocket adapter for the durable DSH assistant-delivery core.
Scoped, bounded, approval-gated long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness agents.
Unofficial OpenAI Codex provider for DeepSeek Harness with ChatGPT subscription sign-in.
Use a local TraeX coding agent as a DeepSeek Harness model provider over ACP.
A durable, fenced cold-start scheduler and isolated Agent runner for DeepSeek Harness.

API-key-free aggregate search (16 domestic+overseas engines with result-layer failure filtering) plus direct target-URL fetch with SSRF protection, as providers for the DeepSeek Harness web seam (ctx.web).
为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的 3D 智能体工作轨迹可视化插件。A 3D agent-work trajectory visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness.
Policy-gated, content-free health and readiness aggregation for DSH assistant services.
Proposal-only, provenance-stable promotion between DSH personal Memory and Wiki.
Bounded, typed preference learning for the DSH personal assistant.
Run DeepSeek Harness from anywhere: one plugin suite with SSH ops, the Git workbench, browser automation and remote access from desktop and mobile.
description.zh: 一个插件搞定 DSH 远程操作：SSH 运维、Git 工作台、浏览器自动化，电脑手机都能用。

description.en: Build named subagents and skills in a sidebar panel, then call any subagent by name in a conversation. Each subagent selects a model, reasoning effort, spawn or fork mode, a tool allowlist and skills; skills can be global, per workspace or per conversation.
description.zh: 在侧栏里创建具名子智能体和技能，并在对话中按名字调用。子智能体可配置模型、思考强度、spawn/fork 启动方式、工具白名单与技能；技能可全局、按工作区或按单个会话生效。

description.en: Compacts a session at 70% context and appends mechanically extracted anchors — first user message, hard requirements, paths, commands, error codes and unresolved items — to the summary; it reuses DSH built-in compaction-basic and adds a /compact-status command.
description.zh: 上下文到 70% 时自动压缩，并把机械抽取的锚点（第一条用户消息、硬性要求、路径/命令/错误码、未完成项）追加到摘要末尾；复用 DSH 原生 compaction-basic，附带 /compact-status 命令。

description.en: Asks a configured advisor model chain for a second opinion on demand; the advisor inherits the full conversation, fails over along the chain, and logs consultations as replayable chat cards.
description.zh: 按需向配置好的顾问模型链征求第二意见；顾问自动继承完整对话，失败沿链顺延，咨询以卡片留痕可回放。

description.en: Bridges an AI DevOps control plane into DeepSeek Harness as native tools for platform health, agent delivery status, synced cloud resources and delivery tasks.
description.zh: 把 AI DevOps 控制台接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供平台健康检查、智能体交付状态、已同步云资源与交付任务等原生工具。

description.en: Connect Atlassian Cloud and self-hosted Jira and Confluence to DeepSeek Harness, with tools and a Jira issue board.
description.zh: 把 Atlassian Cloud 以及自托管的 Jira、Confluence 接入 DeepSeek Harness，提供工具和 Jira 问题看板。

description.en: When a turn is truncated by max-tokens, keeps the model writing inside the same turn instead of ending it with the warning bar and waiting for a manual continue; after a per-turn limit it hands over to cross-turn auto-continue plugins.
description.zh: 被 max-tokens 截断时，让模型在同一轮内继续写下去，而不是弹出截断提示条、等你手动点继续；同轮次数达上限后交给跨轮续写插件。

description.en: Adds a plan-then-execute loop to DSH: /autopilot-on runs grill rounds and writes brief, plan and checklist files, /autopilot-run works the checklist item by item, and after a product-code edit the plugin intercepts the turn boundary and steers the agent through rotating self-review rounds before advancing.
description.zh: 给 DSH 加上「先规划再执行」的闭环：/autopilot-on 通过追问轮次产出 brief、plan、checklist 三个文件，/autopilot-run 按清单逐项执行；产品代码被修改后拦截回合边界，用 steer 让 agent 轮换多个自审视角再推进。

description.en: An independent file session view for DSH, with tree and column navigation, image galleries, JSON inspection, and document previews without replacing the original sidebar.
description.zh: DSH 独立文件会话视图，提供树与层级列导航、图片网格、JSON 查看和文档预览，不替换原侧栏。

description.en: Read-only DSH billing statistics with per-request, per-turn and session costs, equivalent public API pricing, optional bill calibration, and DeepSeek model support.
description.zh: 只读 DSH 计费统计：逐请求、逐轮与会话金额，公开 API 等价价格、可选账单校准，当前支持 DeepSeek 系列模型。

description.en: Pre-boot guard that intercepts malformed client plugins before they break startup, names the offending plugin in the error instead of failing anonymously, isolates it in place so the app still boots, and ships an offline dsh-rescue CLI for profile recovery.
description.zh: 启动前置守卫：在任何 Loader entry 创建前拦下畸形客户端插件，报错时点名是哪个插件（而不是匿名报错），就地兜底隔离保证仍能启动；另附脱机 dsh-rescue 急救 CLI 用于恢复 profile。

description.en: Unifies the conversation flow gap and the indent, margins, card borders and radii of expanded reasoning and tool bodies through CSS variables, with one live stepper per knob in Settings → General.
description.zh: 把对话正文、思考行与工具行的垂直间距，以及展开后正文的缩进、边距、卡片边框与圆角统一到一组 CSS 变量，设置 → 通用 里每个参数都有实时步进器。

description.en: Sidebar hub for the WorkBuddy, Trae, Qoder and MiniMax Code connect plugins: a configurable daily auto check-in (default 10:00, catch-up included) plus one-click or per-platform check-in across every pooled account, per-account credit balance with today's state and expiry, a credit-package breakdown, account add/remove, and one-click joining the pool for an account that is signed in but not yet enrolled. It stores no credential and calls no platform API itself.
description.zh: 侧边栏签到中心，聚合 WorkBuddy、Trae、Qoder、MiniMax Code 四个连接插件：可设定每天几点后自动签到（默认 10:00，关着应用错过的当天会补签），也可一键或按平台为号池内每个账号签到；逐条展示积分余额、今日签到状态与到期时间， 可展开积分包明细，支持添加/移除账号，并可一键把已登录但未入池的账号加入号池。插件自身不保存凭证、不直接访问平台 API。

description.en: Connects one CLIProxyAPI gateway to DeepSeek Harness, speaks OpenAI Responses, Chat Completions, Anthropic Messages or Google Generative AI natively, and imports the gateway model catalog into a settings page where each model can be selected.
description.zh: 把一个 CLIProxyAPI 网关接入 DeepSeek Harness，原生支持 OpenAI Responses、Chat Completions、Anthropic Messages 和 Google Generative AI 四种协议，并把网关的模型目录导入设置页，逐个选择启用哪些模型。

description.en: Model connectivity chips in the DSH session header: click one to send a single real request to that model (green reachable, red failed, hover for latency), and click its arrow to switch the current session to that model.
description.zh: 在 DSH 会话头部常驻一排模型连通性标签：点一下即向该模型发一次真实请求（绿=通、红=不通，悬停可看耗时），点标签上的箭头可把当前会话切换到该模型。

description.en: Consensus academic search and research agent with interactive paper cards and native OAuth.
description.zh: Consensus 学术检索与研究 Agent，支持原生 OAuth 与会话富交互论文卡片。

description.en: Mirrors every session to a standalone readable Markdown file plus a JSONL twin whose name carries date, time and topic, keeps a searchable index beside them, and adds a settings-page search and a model recall tool.
description.zh: 把每个会话镜像成一个可读的独立 Markdown 文件（附同名 JSONL），文件名带日期、时间与话题，旁边维护可检索索引，并提供设置页检索与模型召回工具。

description.en: Copy an assistant message as Markdown, plain text, rich text for Word, TSV, LaTeX or a JSON block tree, from a per-message button or the chat context menu.
description.zh: 从消息操作栏按钮或聊天右键菜单，把助手消息复制为 Markdown、纯文本、可直接粘到 Word 的富文本、TSV、LaTeX 或 JSON 块树。

description.en: Prices each DeepSeek Harness step at the peak or off-peak rate in force when that request ran, then shows the cumulative cost split, this-turn cost, and whether context or budget says to hand off to a fresh session.
description.zh: 把每一步都按请求发出时的峰谷价计价，历史金额不随后续时段或模型切换漂移；在输入框下方给出累计成本拆分、本轮成本，以及「上下文或预算是否到了该交接」的判据与预测。

description.en: Cursor SDK integration with multi-account scheduling, usage tracking, scoped proxies and conversation checkpoints.
description.zh: 集成 Cursor SDK，支持多账号调度、用量统计、专用代理和会话检查点。

description.en: One sidebar panel that shows the remaining credit balance and today's check-in state of every freebie platform already configured on the machine (Loomy, MiniMax Code, Trae, Qoder, Raccoon, WorkBuddy, CodeArts, WPS Lingxi, MobileClaw), read through the plugins that own each platform plus two bundled read-only readers. Query and manual check-in only: no login UI, no stored tokens, and a manual check-in is reported as successful only when the measured balance actually increased.
description.zh: 一个侧栏面板，显示本机已配置的全部白嫖平台的剩余积分与今日签到状态（Loomy、MiniMax Code、Trae、Qoder、Raccoon、WorkBuddy、CodeArts、WPS 灵犀、MobileClaw）；数据通过各平台既有的插件读取，另带两个只读读取器。只做查询与手动签到：不提供登录界面、不保存凭据，且手动签到只有在实测余额确实增加时才显示成功。

description.en: Tactile warm-paper skin for DeepSeek Harness: seven built-in palettes plus AI-designed themes, tight typography, spring sidebar motion, switchable streaming-text reveal and comet caret, per-workspace icons, and draggable sidebar entries with a "More" tray.
description.zh: 暖纸质感的 DSH 皮肤：七套内置配色外加 AI 生成主题，克制的字号与字重，侧栏回弹动效，逐字浮现与彗星光标可开关，工作区自定义图标，侧栏入口可拖动排序、也能收进「更多」。

description.en: Checks the agent’s own claims against the tool output saved in the same session: each sentence carrying a path, a number with a unit, inline code or a URL is graded supported, partial or no evidence, with the anchors it could not find listed. Coverage shows on the composer pill. Heuristic and local — no LLM call, no receipt log, nothing uploaded.
description.zh: 把 Agent 的结论对回同一会话里工具真实返回的内容：含路径、带单位数字、行内代码或 URL 的句子被判定为有据 / 部分有据 / 无据，并列出找不到的锚点。覆盖率显示在输入框胶囊上。纯本地启发式匹配，不调模型、不是日志存证、不上传任何内容。

description.en: Cinematic 10-second cold-start animation with the original soundtrack, a 1.2 s dissolve into a looping anime chat background, and a frosted settings panel for DeepSeek Harness. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供带原声的 10 秒电影感冷启动动画、1.2 秒叠化转场，以及可循环的动漫聊天背景和毛玻璃设置面板。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Pushes a local folder to GitHub on one instruction: proxy autodetection, the token read from the OS credential store and scrubbed from every log line, a pre-push secret gate, and SHA read-back verification of the remote branch.
description.zh: 一句话把本地目录推到 GitHub：自动探测代理，令牌从系统凭据管理器直读并从每行日志里清洗掉，推送前做敏感信息闸门，推送后回读远端分支 SHA 校验。

description.en: GitLab issue kanban for DSH, driven by the glab CLI. Every label-backed list of a project issue board becomes a column; dragging a card swaps its status label. Adds a sidebar panel with a project picker, filters and a card detail drawer (Markdown description, comments and activity, comment, close, reopen), plus a session View tab that resolves the workspace origin remote, and one glab_kanban agent tool over the same operations.
description.zh: 基于 glab 命令行的 GitLab Issue 看板：项目 Issue 看板的每个标签列变成一列，拖拽卡片即切换状态标签。提供侧边栏面板（项目选择、筛选、卡片详情抽屉：Markdown 描述、评论与动态、评论、关闭、重开），以及按工作区 origin 远程自动绑定项目的会话视图标签页，并通过同一个 glab_kanban 工具让 Agent 执行相同操作。

description.en: Turns the DSH Web UI into the Albion's U.C.0083 panoramic cockpit: hangar-door boot sequence, seven-step EFSF self-check, parallax canopy frame, three-section MFD deck, local BGM and a cold dark theme.
description.zh: 把 DSH Web UI 变成阿鲁比昂号的 U.C.0083 全景座舱：舱门启动序列、七项 EFSF 自检、视差座舱框、三段式 MFD 仪表台、本地 BGM 与冷调深色主题。

description.en: Loads a session's full earlier history automatically when it opens instead of only the last page, which also restores the turn-process fold control on long sessions; a toggle in Settings → General turns it off.
description.zh: 打开会话时自动把更早的历史全部加载完，而不是只加载最后一页；长会话的回合过程折叠也会随之恢复。设置 → 通用 可关闭。

description.en: When an image over the 8192 px per-side limit (or 64 MP) would make the Host reject the whole prompt, stores it byte-for-byte as a generic file and hands the model the saved path — no resize, no re-encode — so it can still be viewed or converted, e.g. a long screenshot or a scan to PDF.
description.zh: 图片单边超过 8192px（或总像素超限）导致整条消息被拒收时，把超限图片按原始字节存为普通文件、把只读路径交给模型，不缩放不转码，便于无损查看或转换（如长截图、扫描件转 PDF）。

description.en: Implements DeepSeek Harness's super-agent (router–worker) design on your own machine: a resident router, the Chancellor's Office, splits a request into tasks, triages and queues them by fixed rules without model calls, and starts each one as an isolated worker on its own git worktree and branch, surfacing only what needs your decision; an unattended mode repairs failed audits and archives passed ones. Inside each task the coding CLIs run as a Tang-dynasty court: one tool drafts a plan, a second reviews or vetoes it, six ministries work in parallel by dependency, an inspector checks each output and a final audit runs before you approve, and nothing is merged until then. Supports Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor CLI, OpenCode, Qwen Code, WorkBuddy and DSH itself via dsh headless, with a tool catalog that shows install commands, per-call token and cost accounting with budgets, and an English Roman Senate mode.
description.zh: 在你自己的电脑上实现 DeepSeek Harness 的 super-agent（Router–Worker）设计：常驻的「丞相府」充当总管，把一段需求拆成几道旨，按固定规则分拣、排队、放行（不调模型），每道旨作为隔离的执行者在自己的 git worktree 与分支里办，只把需要你拍板的事报上来；无人值守模式下复核不过自动补救，通过即归档。每道旨内部，本机的 AI 编程命令行排成三省六部：一家拟方案，另一家审议或封驳，六部按依赖并行办差，御史逐件巡查，门下复核后由你批红，批红才合并。支持 Claude Code、Codex、Gemini CLI、Cursor CLI、OpenCode、Qwen Code、WorkBuddy 以及经 dsh headless 的 DSH 本体，内置列出安装命令的工具目录、逐次调用的 token 与花销记账和预算，以及古罗马元老院英文版。

description.en: LAN access gateway for the Web UI: serve DSH on localhost or 0.0.0.0 with password protection or an explicit no-password mode plus expiry presets, and open a separate chat-only port that other agents can drive over HTTP with selectable workspace, token or token-free auth, and its own expiry. LAN sharing is opt-in: it rebinds the Web UI port to 0.0.0.0, gives other devices the full DSH interface behind a password (the default), and an explicit no-password mode needs you to confirm a security warning.
description.zh: DSH 局域网/远程访问网关：把 Web 界面开放在本机或 0.0.0.0（密码保护或显式无密码模式，带过期快捷选项），并单独开放仅对话端口，供其他 Agent 通过 HTTP 接入，支持选择工作区、Token 或免 Token 认证与独立生效时间。局域网分享需要主动开启：它把 Web UI 端口改绑到 0.0.0.0，让其他设备使用完整的 DSH 界面，默认需要密码；不设密码的模式要先确认安全警告。

description.en: Seed dsh plugin-market index sources on startup, so the Discover tab can search and install community plugins right after the bundle is installed.
description.zh: 启动时把插件市场索引源写入 dsh，装完这个包打开「发现」就能搜索并安装社区插件。

description.en: A revert button on every sent message: on confirm it returns that message's text and attachments to the composer, rolls the session back to before that step and restores workspace files to their captured before-content.
description.zh: 每条已发送消息上都有回退按钮：确认后把该消息的文字与附件放回输入框，把会话回滚到这一步之前，并把工作区文件恢复到当时记录的修改前内容。

description.en: Broadcasts the current session's effective model selection as a window event at the moment it changes, for consumers that need the selection before the first request round, such as a balance widget switching its accounting endpoint.
description.zh: 会话当前模型一改变就把选择结果作为 window 事件广播出去，供需要在首个请求回合之前就知道选择的消费者使用（例如余额挂件切换计费接入点）。

description.en: Bind prompts to individual providers and models for use across Standard-mode conversations and subagents.
description.zh: 按提供商和模型绑定提示词，在标准模式的会话与子智能体中使用。

description.en: Adds a model input modalities section to Settings that lists every model grouped by provider route and lets you declare text or image input per model, which is what lets a custom-route model accept image attachments.
description.zh: 在设置页加入「模型输入模态」区块，按 provider 路由分组列出所有模型，可为每个模型勾选是否接受图片输入——自定义路由下的模型就是靠这一项才能收图片附件。

description.en: Connect Notion's official MCP server to DeepSeek Harness for workspace tools and resources.
description.zh: 通过 Notion 官方 MCP 将工作区工具和资源接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Novel writing workspace view with live word counts, chapter cards, frosted-glass panels, and selection-to-AI polish, continuation, and story-direction prompts.
description.zh: 卡片式小说写作工作区：实时字数统计、章节管理、磨砂玻璃面板，选中一段即可让 AI 润色、续写或给出故事方向。

description.en: Adds a peak/off-peak badge to the composer status row, using four switchable provider presets (DeepSeek API, OpenCode Go, WorkBuddy, custom) whose windows come from each vendor's own documentation, with a per-provider public-holiday switch.
description.zh: 在输入框下方状态栏显示当前供应商处于忙时还是闲时，内置四套可切换的供应商预设（DeepSeek 官方 API、OpenCode Go、WorkBuddy、自定义），时段取自各厂商官方文档，并可按供应商单独设置「法定节假日按闲时」。

description.en: A Dynamic-Island-style status panel that lives in the macOS notch and lists running turns, background jobs and subagents, with a completion banner and a spoken reminder.
description.zh: 住在 macOS 刘海里的灵动岛式状态面板，列出正在跑的轮次、后台任务与子 agent，结束时弹出横幅并语音播报。

description.en: Evaluate your available models, compare capability and task time, and choose a configuration that fits your work.
description.zh: 评测你可用的模型，对比能力与耗时，选择适合当前任务的配置。

description.en: Publishes a local DSH plugin folder to GitHub: runs a local preflight, pushes a snapshot through the Git Data API, adds the dsh-plugin topic, and opens the awesome-dsh-plugin listing pull request. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 把本地 DSH 插件一键发布到 GitHub：先做本地体检，再用 Git Data API 推送快照、加上 dsh-plugin 标签，并自动给插件市场开收录 PR。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Draws subscription quota rings for the providers you configured next to the session title, an inner ring for the short window and an outer one for the weekly window.
description.zh: 在会话标题旁为已配置的提供商画订阅额度圆环，内环是短周期，外环是周周期。

description.en: Continue the DeepSeek Harness sessions on your computer from a phone browser: scan a QR code, approve the device on the computer, then chat, answer tool approvals and preview workspace files in the host web interface itself, over the same Wi-Fi or a tunnel.
description.zh: 用手机浏览器继续电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness 会话：扫码并在电脑上确认设备后，在宿主界面里对话、处理工具审批、预览工作区文件；支持同一 Wi-Fi 直连或经转发通道连接。

description.en: Registers a repo_brief tool: one call returns a compact map of a repository — languages, package.json scripts and dependencies, likely entry points, the test command, recently modified and largest files, and top-level directories. Read-only: it stats and reads, never writes or runs commands. Replaces the dozen exploratory calls an agent otherwise spends on an unfamiliar project.
description.zh: 注册 repo_brief 工具：一次调用摸清仓库——语言构成、package.json 脚本与依赖、可能的入口、测试命令、最近修改与最大文件、顶层目录。只读：只做 stat 与读取，不写文件、不执行命令。替代 Agent 进入陌生项目时那十几次探索调用。

description.en: Rewrites DSH shell tool commands through `rtk rewrite` on tools/pre-execute, exposes `rtk` and `rtk_stats` tools, and compresses their results through `rtk pipe`.
description.zh: 在 tools/pre-execute 阶段经 `rtk rewrite` 改写 DSH 的 shell 工具命令，提供 `rtk` 与 `rtk_stats` 工具，并用 `rtk pipe` 压缩结果。

description.en: Schedule a message to be sent in the current conversation later: after this turn finishes, every N hours and minutes for a set number of repetitions, or at a clock time on chosen days (once / daily / weekly / monthly). The message arrives as the user's own words, delivered through the same channel as typing a prompt, and a card above the composer lists the pending sends with a countdown. Also registers schedule_send / schedule_cancel tools so an agent can set its own wake-ups: come back in N minutes, check again at a given time, or after the current turn ends.
description.zh: 在当前会话里排一条定时发送的消息：本轮结束后发、每隔 X 小时 Y 分钟发 N 次，或按选定的日期时间发（不重复 / 每天 / 每周几 / 每月几号）。消息以用户自己的口吻送达，走与手动输入 prompt 同一条通道；输入框上方有待发送卡片和倒计时。另注册 schedule_send / schedule_cancel 工具，让 Agent 也能给自己定闹钟：过 N 分钟回来复查、指定时刻提醒、或本轮结束后再动手。

description.en: Clicking a sidebar search result opens the session, scrolls to the row that matches the search snippet and highlights it briefly.
description.zh: 点击侧栏搜索结果后打开会话、滚动到与搜索片段对应的那一行，并短暂高亮。

description.en: Manage SSH servers and NAS web UIs from the DSH sidebar, including status probes, Docker control, PVE updates, and 1Panel app versions.
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧栏集中管理 SSH 服务器与 NAS，查看状态、控制 Docker、检查 PVE 更新与 1Panel 应用版本。

description.en: Manage local background services in DSH Desktop/Web, with persistent start/stop policies, process identity checks, and an authenticated registration CLI.
description.zh: 在 DSH Desktop/Web 中管理本地后台服务，支持持久启停策略、进程身份校验和需认证的服务登记 CLI。

description.en: Lifts the built-in cap of three @ referenced sessions per message by rewriting the reference resolver's config after it is instantiated, defaulting to 8 with an aggregate context budget guard; no app.asar changes.
description.zh: 解除原生「一条消息最多 @ 引用 3 个会话」的上限：在解析器实例化之后改写其 config，默认放宽到 8，并按总上下文预算反算单条额度；不改 app.asar。

description.en: Select text in a DSH conversation to ask it in a side chat, translate it with context-aware one-to-five candidate renderings, or explain the term, without touching the main transcript. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里选中文字，三选一：开侧边子会话提问、结合上下文给出 1-5 个候选译法、或解释该名词，都不会写入主对话。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: A sidebar tool for DeepSeek Harness: switch between the card list and the native list, group workspaces and plugins into categories you create, and browse the project file tree in place.
description.zh: 一个侧边栏工具：可在卡片列表与原生列表之间切换，并支持工作区分组管理、插件分组管理以及项目文件树浏览。

description.en: A star button beside the composer that rewrites the current draft into a clearer, more complete prompt with the session default model; it reads up to five recent user prompts from the same session as read-only context, writes the result back into the composer, and never sends the message.
description.zh: 在输入框旁加一颗星星按钮，用会话默认模型把当前草稿改写得更完整清晰；改写前会读取本会话最近最多 5 条用户提示词作为只读上下文，结果回填到输入框而不直接发送。

description.en: Recovers known invalid explicit model arguments in DSH subagent and subagent_fork calls by removing the full override and retrying once through the original guarded pipeline.
description.zh: 恢复 DSH subagent 与 subagent_fork 调用中已知的无效显式模型参数，移除完整覆盖后通过原有守卫管线重试一次。

description.en: A proactive coding agent as a DSH bundle: it listens to GitHub issues and comments, and optionally Feishu, DingTalk and WeCom, turns requests from authorized people into tickets, runs each ticket in its own DSH session and git worktree, and replies in the original thread with a branch or pull request.
description.zh: 以 DSH bundle 形式发布的主动式编码智能体：监听 GitHub 的 issue 与评论，也可接入飞书、钉钉、企业微信，把有权限的人提出的请求开成工单，每条工单在自己的 DSH 会话与 git worktree 里执行，并回到原话题以分支或 PR 回话。

description.en: Desktop-style client theme for DeepSeek Harness: translucent slate sidebar, #151517 main canvas and #2c2c2e composer dock, four palette presets (obsidian-origin, glacier-midnight, titanium-noir, sonoma-frost), a settings panel for blur, sidebar opacity, ambient glow and content radius, and three GPU performance tiers (ultra, balanced, eco).
description.zh: DSH 客户端桌面级主题：冷灰蓝半透明侧栏、#151517 主画布与 #2c2c2e 输入坞，四套配色预设（深空曜石 / 极夜冰川 / 钛金灰羽 / 晨雾银砂），带模糊度、侧栏浓淡、微光与圆角设置面板，以及极致光影 / 均衡流畅 / 低功耗省电三档 GPU 流畅度。

description.en: Counts the tool calls the agent makes without calling todo_write and injects an advisory reminder when it goes too long, and warns when the list is batch-checked at the end, so the Tasks panel stops showing a stale snapshot.
description.zh: 统计智能体连续多少次工具调用没有更新 todo_write，超过阈值就插入一条提醒；到末尾一次性勾选时也会警告。目的是让「任务」面板不再长时间停在旧快照上。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration controller for DSH — tiers, staged receipts, a token ledger and a run panel on top of the official Agent Teams. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 多代理编排控制器：在官方 Agent Teams 之上提供档位、分阶段回执、token 台账与运行面板。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: AI re-reads every tool's manual on every reply, including the tools you never use. Hide the ones you don't need and rewrite the manuals of the ones you keep — a tool's own manual or any single parameter's. Rewriting touches only the wording, never the schema, so a rewritten tool still works. Both the settings page and a model-callable tool write the same config; changes apply after a restart. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: AI 每回答一次，都要把手上所有工具的说明书重读一遍，包括你从来用不到的那些。这个插件让你把用不上的收起来，并把留下的说明书改成你自己的话——工具本身的说明，或者任意一个参数的说明。改写只动文字、不碰参数格式，所以改过的工具照常能用。设置页和模型可调用的管理工具写的是同一份配置；改动重启后生效。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Sweeps the dsh web conversation list: a standalone page lists every stored session by workspace with official titles, batch-archives the ungrouped test ones through the workspace registry (stopping running work first), restores them anytime, and physically purges archived sessions as an explicit second stage. Ships a client half that adds a sidebar launcher button.
description.zh: 会话清扫器：独立页面按分组列出全部对话（标题读官方 dsh-session-title 缓存），一键归档未分组的测试对话（走官方 workspace 注册表、先停运行任务），随时恢复；彻底删除作为独立第二阶段、仅限已归档会话。内置客户端注入，在原生侧边栏加清扫入口按钮。零依赖。

description.en: Native cards inside DSH replies: when the model writes a vellum code block, it renders as a theme-following metrics, chart, comparison, checklist, steps, timeline, form, quiz or sortable table card; clicks, submits and answers come back to the conversation as the next message.
description.zh: DSH 回复里的原生卡片：模型写一个 vellum 代码块，就渲染成跟随主题的指标、图表、方案对比、清单、步骤、时间线、表单、小测和可排序表格；点选、提交、答题的结果作为下一条消息回到对话。

description.en: Persistent sidebar card for your Volcengine recharge balance and Ark Coding/Agent plan windows, with in-card AK/SK setup and per-provider toggles.
description.zh: 侧边栏常驻卡片，显示火山引擎账户充值余额与方舟 Coding/Agent 套餐窗口，内置 AK/SK 配置与逐项显示开关。

description.en: Weekly retro for DSH: sessions, repeats, candidate skills and a five-tab insights UI, all local. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: DSH 周报复盘：会话画像、重复劳动、技能候选与五 Tab 洞察页，数据只在本机。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。

description.en: Re-anchors two contracts at the very top of the system prompt before every model step: English chain-of-thought with Simplified-Chinese user-facing prose, and final summaries that carry every fact the user saw.
description.zh: 在每一步请求前把两条契约重新钉到系统提示最顶部：内部推理用英文、面向用户的文字用简体中文；最终总结必须自包含、包含用户在过程中看到过的所有关键信息。

description.en: Adds a DeepSeek Harness workbench and skill for rebuilding STL meshes as editable SolidWorks parts on Windows.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中提供工作台和技能，在 Windows 上调用本机 SolidWorks 将 STL 重建为可编辑零件。

description.en: Talk to your current DSH Agent without switching presets: automatic speech transcription and sending, streamed spoken replies, voice interruption, and a five-bar microphone meter. Choose DeepSeek or Doubao independently for ASR and TTS, configure your own credentials, and edit instructions applied only during calls. Includes an illustrated setup guide.
description.zh: 直接与当前 DSH Agent 语音交谈，无需切换预设：停顿后自动识别并发送，回复流式播报，支持说话打断与五段声条反馈。识别和合成可分别选择 DeepSeek 或豆包，在设置中配置自己的凭据，通话规则仅在通话期间注入；附图文安装与使用指南。

description.en: 屏蔽 Enter 发送：Enter 只换行，消息只能点按钮发出去 · DeepSeek Harness 插件（npm: dsh-no-enter-sand）
description.zh: 让 Enter 只换行不发送，消息只能点发送按钮发出，避免误发。

description.en: Takes Enter away from sending in the DSH composer: Enter inserts a line break, every Ctrl/Cmd/Alt+Enter variant is swallowed, and messages leave only from the send button. A gray hint in the input box says so before the first keystroke and stays beside the button while typing.
description.zh: 让 Enter 不再发送：在 DSH 输入框里按 Enter 只换行，Ctrl/Cmd/Alt+Enter 一律吞掉，消息只能点发送按钮发出去。输入框灰字提示「已屏蔽Enter 发送」，空输入时接在占位符后面，开始打字后常驻发送按钮左侧。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness 提示词优化器：把一句话草稿改写成精准提示词，替换前逐行 diff 审阅、替换后 9 秒撤销，带版本历史、模板体系与中英双语界面。
description.zh: 把一句话草稿改写成精准提示词，替换前逐行 diff 审阅、替换后 9 秒可撤销，还带版本历史和模板。

description.en: Evolution mode in one package: a thinking mode that aligns on your goal and boundaries each turn plus the task tree, profile injection and panel, alignment-bar styling, self-check tools and plan-mode entry — install one package and you have the whole set. It helps the model understand requests more accurately, get noticeably better results at the same cost, and build a long-term profile of your preferences. Its HTTP routes have no DSH access check, so a web page open in your browser could call them.
description.zh: 进化模式一包装全：一个每轮先对齐目标与边界的思维模式，连任务树、画像注入与面板、对齐栏样式、自查工具、计划模式入口一起装；装一个包就是整套。让模型更准确地理解你的需求、用相同的花费做出明显更好的效果，并长期积累你的偏好。它的 HTTP 路由没有 DSH 的访问检查，浏览器里打开的网页可以调用它们。
